an3.103:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pubbeva me bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi :
an3.103:1.2: ko nu kho loke assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
an3.103:1.4: yaṃ kho loke paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ loke assādo.
an3.103:1.5: yaṃ loko anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammo, ayaṃ loke ādīnavo.
an3.103:1.6: yaṃ loke chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ loke nissaraṇanti.
an3.103:1.7: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, evaṃ lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake- sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.103:1.8: yato ca kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, evaṃ lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake- sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.103:1.10: “akuppā me cetovimutti ayamantimā jāti, natthi’dāni punabbhavo”ti.
